name: Experience Abu Dhabi (Dept. of Culture and Tourism - Abu Dhabi)
verdict: Experience Abu Dhabi is the official tourism authority of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, a state government entity.
note: Rating note: Ultimate owner is the Government of Abu Dhabi, a state entity, which places it in the serious tier per rubric (state owner).

why.text: Experience Abu Dhabi is a tourism brand of the Abu Dhabi government, part of the United Arab Emirates. In 2024, a UAE court gave 43 people, including human rights defenders, life sentences after a single mass trial that human rights monitors called unfair, and in March 2025 the UAE’s Federal Supreme Court upheld the convictions. A tourism brand on a famous jersey makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: In 2024, 43 activists in the UAE got life sentences in one mass trial, and the convictions were upheld in 2025.
